name: atk-battery-streamdeck
description: Stream Deck key showing ATK A9-family mouse battery, read from the ATK Battery tray app

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin.js --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=com.jb.atk-battery.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.jb.atk-battery.sdPlugin --force -o dist
